name: kb_check
description: Run KB validation rules and return violations, quality diagnostics, and typed kibi.migration-plan.v2 actions. Use before or after mutations and after source edits; checks remain read-only and never infer or apply actions from prose suggestions.

rules.description: Optional rule subset. Allowed: must-priority-coverage, symbol-coverage, symbol-traceability, symbol-granularity, symbol-coordinates-missing, no-dangling-refs, source-relationship-parity, branch-store-not-compiled, source-path-dangling, no-cycles, required-fields, deprecated-adr-no-successor, superseded-requirement-open, scenario-feasibility, scenario-feasibility-unknown, scenario-outcome-mismatch, exception-claim-keys, numeric-string-value, rule-key-arguments-missing, domain-contradictions, logic-coverage, rule-safety, rule-verifiability, query-plan-safety, req-status-vocabulary, retired-reason-missing, retired-owner-only, strict-fact-shape, strict-req-fact-pairing, predicate-verifiability, strict-readiness, semantic-completeness, related-requirement-unmodeled, claim-subject-missing, claim-subject-undefined, proof-contract-symbols, entity-id-style, domain-redundancy, domain-implication, subject-key-identity, subject-key-shape, ontology-quality, exception-unapproved, exception-approval-self-attested, agent-requirement-unapproved, requirement-rationale-missing, symbol-owner-superseded, adr-unlinked, adr-proposed, predicate-schema-conformance, entity-context-missing, subject-definition-missing, subject-duplicate, quantity-duplicate, subject-hierarchy-invalid, entity-context-acknowledged, decision-firm-unreferenced, decision-firm-superseded, decision-firm-edited, supersedes-reason-missing, supersedes-reason-acknowledged, policy-ownership, policy-markers, kb-consistency, kb-consistency-unresolved, evidence-floor, agent-requirement-unapproved-implemented, must-positive-scenario, proof-contract-claims. If omitted, server runs canonical and advisory rules plus the full-KB qualityDiagnostics audit scan, including usage telemetry acceptance when evidence exists; migration rules run only when explicitly selected. Advisory and migration findings are non-blocking qualityDiagnostics. If supplied, server preserves scoped validation and skips the full-KB advisory scan.
rules.x-kibi-advertised-description: Optional rule names (an unknown one is refused with the list). Omit to run every rule plus the full-KB audit.

sourceFiles.description: Optional repo-relative source files to inspect for early impact diagnostics. Use with includeImpactDiagnostics after meaningful source edits. Scopes the result to those files: blocking violations are listed for entities the changed symbols link to, entities whose KB document changed, and store-level rules; the rest are counted in omittedViolations (count still includes them). The migration plan comes as migrationPlanSummary, and a result over its size budget is cut (truncated: true).
sourceFiles.x-kibi-advertised-description: Optional repo-relative source files to inspect for impact diagnostics; scopes violations to what they touch.

includeMigrationPlan.description: Return the full migrationPlan (its actions, for kb_apply_plan) instead of migrationPlanSummary, which a check with sourceFiles always gives and any other check gives when the result is over its size budget.
includeMigrationPlan.x-kibi-advertised-description: Return the full migrationPlan (for kb_apply_plan) even when the result would show only its summary.

offset.description: With rules: the first finding to list. A rule selection lists its findings in pages that keep to the size budget, and a cut page names the next offset.
offset.x-kibi-advertised-description: With rules: the first finding to list; findings come in pages within the size budget.

includeSymbolDebt.description: Without rules or sourceFiles: list the unrecorded declarations per file under symbolDebt.files. By default symbolDebt carries only total and fileCount; the debt never blocks.
includeSymbolDebt.x-kibi-advertised-description: Without rules or sourceFiles: list unrecorded declarations per file (symbolDebt has counts only by default).

staged.description: When true, inspect staged source changes for impact diagnostics using the shared CLI impact analyzer without shelling out to kibi check.
staged.x-kibi-advertised-description: When true, inspect staged source changes for impact diagnostics, as kibi check --staged does.

changed.description: When true, run the commit gate (kibi check --staged) over the working tree plus the index, as a commit of every current change would be judged, without touching the real index; with sourceFiles, only those files and .kb are added. Returns commitAllowed and the gate's findings, each with blocks: "commit" when it refuses the commit or "none" when it is advice. Without changed, each finding carries blocks: "merge" (fails the full check run in CI), "commit" (a blocking impact diagnostic) or "none". Use after editing code, before finishing: it is the verdict git commit will give.
changed.x-kibi-advertised-description: When true, give the commit gate's verdict on every current change (commitAllowed, findings with blocks).

includeWorkingTreeDiff.description: When true, inspect current unstaged working-tree diffs for impact diagnostics. Pair with sourceFiles to scope the analysis.
includeWorkingTreeDiff.x-kibi-advertised-description: When true, inspect unstaged working-tree diffs for impact diagnostics; pair with sourceFiles to scope.

includeImpactDiagnostics.description: When true, include changed-file impact diagnostics such as symbol_granularity_violation, symbol_semantic_review_needed, source_file_unowned and requirement_statement_unverified (each current requirement the changed code implements, with its statement and firmness, since the check never compares code with a statement) in structured output.
includeImpactDiagnostics.x-kibi-advertised-description: When true, include changed-file impact diagnostics (granularity, ownership, statements to verify) in the output.

maxDiagnostics.description: Optional maximum number of impact diagnostics to return. Graph validation violations are not capped by this value.

workspaceRoot.description: Optional workspace root for impact diagnostics. Defaults to the MCP server workspace.

async.description: When true, start the check as a background job and return a kibi.job.v1 receipt immediately instead of holding the request until the tool timeout. Poll kb_job_status with the returned jobId. Use for full checks on large KBs that exceed the configured tool timeout. The MCP server registers kb_job_status only when KIBI_MCP_OPTIONAL_TOOLS includes it; otherwise async runs the check synchronously.
async.x-kibi-advertised-description: When true, run as a background job and return a kibi.job.v1 receipt to poll with kb_job_status.

data.description: Synchronous check payload, or a kibi.job.v1 receipt when async:true detached the check into a background job (poll kb_job_status with the jobId).

impactAdvice.description: Advice that impact diagnostics share, once each. An impact diagnostic whose advice is an index into this list carries no suggestion of its own.

changed.description: Set by changed:true: the commit gate judged the working tree plus the index.

commitAllowed.description: changed:true only. True when a commit of these changes passes the commit gate.

symbolDebt.description: Unscoped checks only. Declarations without a symbol record in source files that have at least one record, as counts; files lists them only with includeSymbolDebt. Non-blocking: the staged gate judges them only when a commit adds or changes them.
